I bought a large outdoor solar shade and I love it. What a difference it’s made in my utility bill. My house is cooler and I can actually enjoy my back patio now. Shutter Shop was such a great experience. I try to shop small business when possible and this is a great local company. Great people who actually care about their customers.

any pressure to buy. Melissa was very professional and it was great working with Mark on the installation. Great team and great service!!

Shutter Shop LLC is awesome! The staff is extremely professional and I got my order way ahead of schedule. I ordered outdoor window screens for my west facing windows. It’s made a gigantic difference in the heat coming through my living room. Thanks for such a quick and wonderful experience.
